scripts.build: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build && cp README.md dist/
scripts.build:cv: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment cv
scripts.build:birthday: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment birthday
scripts.build:scotland-rail: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment scotland-rail
scripts.build:crimson-desert-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment crimson-desert-save-editor
scripts.build:spooners: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment spooners
scripts.build:design: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment design
scripts.build:deadly-days-roadtrip-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment deadly-days-roadtrip-save-editor
scripts.build:cyberpunk-2077-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment cyberpunk-2077-save-editor
scripts.build:dysmantle-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment dysmantle-save-editor
scripts.build:no-rest-for-the-wicked-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment no-rest-for-the-wicked-save-editor
scripts.build:power-fantasy-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment power-fantasy-save-editor
scripts.build:tails-of-iron-2-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment tails-of-iron-2-save-editor
scripts.build:witcher-3-save-editor: bun run clean && bun run generate && rsbuild build --environment witcher-3-save-editor
scripts.deploy: published=; trap '[ -n "$published" ] && rm -rf dist' EXIT; bun run build && gh-pages --dist dist --branch master && published=1
scripts.check: bun run --sequential check:clean check:oxlint check:biome check:export lint
scripts.check:ci: oxlint --quiet && biome check . && ts-unused-exports tsconfig.json --ignoreFiles=rsbuild.config.ts && tsc --noEmit
scripts.generate: bun run src/birthday/_genIcs.ts && bun run src/shared/_genManifests.ts
